text:
ida: paging — multiple alerts: canary pods in inference-cluster are backoff/crashlooping after today's canary deploy. errors look like mount failures + probe timeouts. tagging oncall.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered (P1) — service: inference-canary, runbook: https://redwood/runs/inference-canary

sanjay: I'm on it, pulling logs now. which canary version rolled? deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-15T09:23 UTC -> image:redwood/inference:v3.4-canary

eleine (typo) — ignore

elaine: FYI the canary rollout had the new init container that fetches certs. just remembered a change to the init volume mount in the manifest.

ida: ok look at one of the crashed pods: kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=encoder-canary

sanjay: logs: "failed to mount tmp: permission denied" from init-container, then liveness probe fails and SIGTERM. crashing fast.

ida: is this affecting host pool nodes also? ops_shift: yes, ~30% of canary replicas timed out; some nodes showing node.kubelet.backoff for evictions.

ops_shift: I see node-level OOMs on gpunode-13 where the canary landed — but the init mount error is first thing in container logs.

elaine: we changed mountPath in the init volume to /run/cert-fetch but the main container expects /etc/certs. cfg mismatch in the canary manifest.

sanjay: that explains crashloop. but why some nodes OOM? HPA reacted to failed readiness and tried to spin more pods, hitting memory pressure. HPA minReplicas was 0 and cooldown low.

ida: customer-impact? customer-support: Intermittent 503s from a subset of customers using the new inference route (canary=true). Major customers on Dedicated unaffected. Hosted API saw increased tail latency for small percentage of requests routed to canary.

ida: mitigation plan: (1) pause canary traffic routing (kill-switch feature flag) (2) scale down canary deployment to 0 (3) rollback manifest or fix mount path and redeploy canary behind gated traffic.

sanjay: performing kill-switch toggle now: /internal/flags?toggle=canary-inference-traffic&state=off -> toggled. Confirmed routing now goes to stable model.

deploy-bot: Flag update recorded — canary-inference-traffic: OFF by ida @2512346905

ida: scaling down canary replica set: kubectl -n inference scale rs encoder-canary-20260315 --replicas=0

ops_shift: scaled. watching nodes — memory pressure easing, OOM events dropping.

elaine: opening a rollback PR for the canary manifest to revert init mount change. PR: https://git/repo/pull/482

sanjay: temporarily removing HPA from the canary namespace to prevent scale flapping: kubectl -n inference delete hpa encoder-canary-hpa --now

ida: do we need to notify customers? customer-support: sending an incident message to affected customers: concise note + ETA for fix. Escalate to account owners for top 5 impacted.

ops_shift: one pod still in CrashLoopBackOff due to node taint leftover. I'll cordon gpunode-13 and drain safely after scale-down to clear leftovers: kubectl cordon gpunode-13; kubectl drain gpunode-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force

elaine: rolling issue root-cause: manifest changed mountPath variable name from cert_mount -> certPath in helm values; template left mismatch. We'll add a helm test and template lint to CI.

ida: timeline for rollback and redeploy? elaine: PR merged in 20m once tests pass; redeploy as a gated canary behind traffic flag. will coordinate with devex to add an integration test for init mount.

sanjay: reopening HPA after stability confirmed; set minReplicas=2 for canary to avoid HPA hitting 0 next time. Also add burst protection (cooldown 300s).

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: image pinned to redwood/inference:v3.3-stable for canary group @2512346935

ida: postmortem owners: elaine (manifest/CI fix), sanjay (oncall mitigation & HPA hardening), ops_shift (node recovery/process). I'll create the incident postmortem doc and include customer impact, timeline, and follow-ups.

customer-support: outgoing customer note sent. will attach request ids and latency graphs.

ida: handoff to next oncall @ops_shift — incident transitioning to recovery. If anything regresses ping here.

oncall-bot: Incident P1 resolved — auto-close timer started. Please fill runbook steps and links in the postmortem template: https://redwood/incidents/template

sanjay: quick action items: 1) add helm lint CI gate for mount path template 2) harder HPA defaults 3) automated feature-flag kill-switch smoke test 4) add canary traffic signage in console.

ida: thanks everyone. closing thread once postmortem is filed. :thumbsup:
